description: Append a private trend for explicit subject_type self, or a person through a matching condition_id/person_id. Corrections supersede a point and retain history. ($0.05; API key required)

correction_reason.description: Required with supersedes_id; what was wrong with the prior point.

metric.description: What was measured, e.g. severity, completed, energy or duration_minutes.

observed_at.description: When it applied, as an ISO timestamp.

person_id.description: Owned contact id; required for person.

request_id.description: Client idempotency key (retries return original result).

source.description: Provenance, e.g. user_reported, condition_checkin, daily_checkin or sleep_record.

supersedes_id.description: The effective trend point this correction replaces.

value.description: A scalar value. Put its scale or measurement in unit.

name: record_health_trend

idempotent_replay.description: true when this request_id already ran: the first result, nothing new written.

title: Record Health Trend
